title: AgentRequest
description: request part of POST /v1/agent (render service). The phone uploads one whole {moment_id}.mp4 per candidate clip; the agent selects, trims, edits and renders the video itself. Rules the schema cannot express are in README.

effective_target_s.description: README, Effective target. The video's total_s must be within ±10 % of it.

context.description: Trip details for the graphics (titles, captions).

clips.description: Every candidate clip after the phone's pre-pass. One {moment_id}.mp4 part per entry.

moment_id.description: Also names the clip's file part, so it is restricted to filename-safe characters.

event_type.description: From Stage 2. Null when the cloud never described the clip (local_fallback, or a button clip whose description failed).

description.description: Stage 2 description, only what is visible. Null under the same conditions as event_type.

score.description: The phone's local score L for ai and local_fallback clips; null for button clips.

t_from_ms.description: Clip start on the trip clock (TRD 5.1). Used for chronological order.

duration_s.description: Duration of the uploaded file: the whole clip, re-encoded at the upload preset.

proposed_in_s.description: Pre-pass best sub-window start, seconds from the clip file's start.

low_fps_lead_in_s.description: Seconds at the start of the clip file recorded below 30 fps (TRD 4.3). 0 if none. A speed ramp is allowed only inside this lead-in.
